clauses.title: Requirements
clauses.text: 1.1 Requirements  for  ductile iron fittings for pressure pipes for water, gas and sewage sizes for 80 to 200mm nominal diameter .

clauses.title: Applicable to fittings meant
clauses.text: 1.2 Applicable to fittings meant for mechanical joints (bolted gland), push on joints and flanged joints for jointing by means of various types of gasket. The design of socket and gasket are not within the scope.

clauses.title: Does not restrict use
clauses.text: 1.3 Does not restrict use and development of other types of joints as long as they maintain overall dimensions for safety and interchargability.

clauses.title: Are normally supplied with
clauses.text: 1.4 Are normally supplied with externally and internally coated to protect against corrosion.

clauses.title: A suitable for fluid
clauses.text: 1.5 A suitable for fluid temperature between 0°C and 50 cC excluding frost.

clauses.title: Manufacture
clauses.text: 2.1 Manufacture — Metal used for manufacture of casting shall conform to the appropriate grade specified in IS 1865 : 1991*

clauses.title: Thickness – C is
clauses.text: 2.2 Thickness - C is calculated by using e      = K ( 0.5 + 0.001 DN) where k      = 14, 12 dn  =  Nominal Diameter

clauses.title: Tensile test
clauses.text: 3.1 Tensile test Nominal      Type of    Tensile         Elongatton  at Diameter    casting   Strength     break, percent (Mpa) (Min)     (Min) All size      Fittings         420 5

clauses.title: Hardness test
clauses.text: 3.2 Hardness test— Shall not exceed 250 HBS.

clauses.title: Hydrostatic test
clauses.text: 4. Hydrostatic test— Shall withstand the pressure test without showing any leakage at prescribed test pressure.

clauses.title: Sizes
clauses.text: 5. Sizes— Nominal sizes of 80, 100, 125, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350, 400, 450, 600, 700, 750, 800, 900, 1000, 1100, 1200, 1400, 1600, 1800 and 2000 mm. Note - For dimensional and other requirements for socket/ spigot of push on joints, mechanical joints and flanges. See table 3 to 7 and for fittings table 15 to 31. Tolerances for various dimension of flanges shall be as given in tables 8 to 11. Tolerances in ovaliyty  is as given in table 12  and  13.

clauses.title: External coatings one of the following
clauses.text: 6.1 External coatings one of the following a) Metallic zinc  with finishing layer (Annex-A) b) Zinc rich paint with finishing layer (Annex-A) c) Bituminous paint (Annx C) d) External steerig (Annex D)

clauses.title: Internal lining
clauses.text: 6.2 Internal lining — following lining may be applied. a) Post land cement (with or without additives) mortar (Annex-B) b) Blast furnace slag cement mortar (Annex-B) c) High alumina cement  mortar (Aannex-B) d) Cement mortar with seal coat (Annex B) e) Bituminus- paint (Annex C) SUMMARY OF IS  9523 : 2000 DUCTILE IRON FITTINGS FOR PRESSURE PIPES FOR WATER, GAS AND SEWAGE (First Revision) *Iron castings with spheroidal  modular or modular graphite (third revision) For detailed information, refer to IS 9523 : 1980 Specification for ductile iron fittings, for pressure pipes for water  gas and sewage.
